easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Lagrella until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
